notes:
• Smoother ads: full-screen ads come only when you return from something you finished, never in the middle of browsing.
• Bank of India accounts no longer appear twice as "ICICI" (UPI IDs like name@okicici no longer decide the bank).
• 4-digit PIN that opens as soon as you type it — no Done button.
• Ask: the newest answer is on top, and lists read as bullets with the amount last.
• Tag a payee as a friend or family member from the category picker or People you pay often; tap a person to see their payments.
• Pro pass shows the time left; balance-check numbers updated from the banks' own websites (Bank of India's has changed).
• Three home-screen widgets: spending with a donut of where it went, budget left with a daily allowance, and your next bills and dues. Choose the period, accounts and what they show in Settings › Home-screen widgets.
• Settings › Notifications: choose which alerts you get, a daily or Sunday money brief at the time you prefer (it learns when you usually look), and quiet hours at night.
• Salary check: at month end, if no salary message came, FinInsight gently asks so Money in stays right (add it once or every month, not yet, or no salary).
• A daily minute: sort 3 payments, today's insight, weekly challenges, and 2 hours of Pro for a 7-day streak (double it with one ad).
• Suggest a feature from Help, and Report a problem now opens your email app directly.
• No internet? Free features keep working; features opened with ads pause with a clear note (your data never leaves the phone) and carry on when you're back online.
• Every credit-card and UPI Lite payment now shows, including card alerts worded "has been used for", "was charged" and "transaction … was made on your card".
• Card bills and UPI Lite or wallet top-ups still show, marked "Not counted", with a line explaining why: each purchase was already counted once.
• Sharper reading of bank messages, and no double counting of card bills, wallet top-ups (Paytm, UPI Lite) or UPI Circle payments.
• Service messages are never counted: credit-limit changes, app activations, card dispatch, reward points and similar notices no longer appear as money spent or received.
• Balance replies such as "Balances are 6048XXXXXXX0099: 103216.45" update the account at once, and new bank messages are picked up as soon as you open the app, even if the phone held back the SMS alert.
• Accounts are known by their last digits: card numbers like 4375X7001 are read, a wallet no longer takes the number of the bank account that loaded it, and messages without a number join the account in use at the time.
• Goal and deposit contributions (such as ICICI iWish) count as savings, never as income. NPS contribution messages are kept as a record and not counted.
• Accounts & cards: accounts with no activity for 6 months move to "Not in use", out of Home and the account chooser. Mark any account in use or not.
• A full app tour that opens every tab and page as it explains it. Skipped it? Finish it any time from the menu or the Guide.
• Bills tell the truth: an older bill from the same biller shows as "probably paid", a late one as overdue, and every due figure opens the bill messages behind it. Ask "how much is pending with Airtel".
• Home's chart shows each day's spending this month against a usual day last month, tap a bar for the day; switch to the running total, drawn only up to today.
• "Spending is up/down" compares like with like: this month so far against last month to the same day, from the 7th.
• UPI Lite: named "ICICI UPI Lite", an estimated balance from the last top-up and what was paid since, and a nudge to add who you paid.
• Wealth: balance over time includes your bank's balance messages, old accounts are left out, and investments show what you put in over the last 12 months by type, with your usual SIP.
• Friends & family: one person written two ways (Yogita Pakhrot, yogitapakhrot) is one entry.
• ATM cash can no longer be filed as an investment by a rule saved for an unnamed payment.
• Tax: your own figures first (80C, NPS, 80D, interest, gross salary, TDS), editable at any time; room left in each deduction; a clear estimate until you add your gross salary.
• New categories for money received, including straight from "I received".
• Quiet hours: choose when they start and end.
• The ☰ menu lists each feature once, with "Needs you" on top when something waits.
• A new animated tour that points at the exact place, moves on by itself (pause any time), and comes back with a "New" badge after each update.
• Drift: a calm, slowly moving background in your own colours (Customise › Background).
• Calculators (Plan, Wealth or the menu): SIP and goal, loan EMI and prepayment, FD and RD, starting from your own usual SIP and EMIs. Move a slider and see the result and chart change.
• Free version: "How ads work here" in the menu tells you plainly what to expect — a small banner and at most 6 full-screen ads a day, never in the middle of a task — and that they support development.
